notes: Do not commit downloaded model binaries to this repository.
This manifest intentionally lists source pages and target folders first. Add direct download URLs locally only after checking each upstream license/model card.
The goal is to bring the repo to the point where Copilot can prepare folders/scripts and the user can do manual node placement in ComfyUI.

entries.purpose: 1-image face animation: blink, mouth, head and upper-body micro motion
entries.install_note: ComfyUI-LivePortraitKJ can auto-download the pack on first run when models/liveportrait is missing.

entries.purpose: Keep Amemiya/Maho/Komori face/style identity from reference images
entries.install_note: Download the SD1.5 plus and plus-face IPAdapter files listed by the upstream README.

entries.purpose: Vision encoder required by many SD1.5 IPAdapter workflows
entries.install_note: Place the CLIP-ViT-H-14-laion2B-s32B-b79K file in models/clip_vision with the expected upstream name.

entries.purpose: Pose and edge control from user-recorded driving videos or reference art
entries.install_note: Install OpenPose and Canny ControlNet models appropriate to the checkpoint you use.
The node can fetch many assets on first use. Let Manager/node download only the preprocessors you actually use.

entries.purpose: Short 1-3 second motion experiments beyond LivePortrait
entries.install_note: Start with one SD1.5 motion module only. Add Motion LoRAs later if needed.

entries.purpose: Optional face detector; check license before use
entries.install_note: Only use if you accept the non-commercial restriction. Prefer MediaPipe for early tests.
